'''Knash''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who was the jailer at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Tremel]] had sent a promising young [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Acolyte]] to Knash's prison cells with a mission to interrogate and judge three prisoners: [[Solentz]], [[Devotek]], and [[Brehg]]. When the acolyte arrived, they witnessed Knash use a shock collar on the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Vette]]. Knash introduced the Acolyte to the three prisoners and guided them through the interrogation, leaving them to decide the prisoner's fates. Knash reported the results to Tremel.<ref name="TOR:JAE">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Judge and Executioner|[[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]}}</ref>

Knash later released Vette into the hands of the acolyte, who required [[Gender/Legends|her]] help in breaching the [[Tomb of Naga Sadow]] during their final trials.<ref name="The Final Trial">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|The Final Trial|[[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]}}</ref>
